title: Stir Fry
description: A simple Chinese stir fry recipe with a variety of vegetables and your choice of protein.

ingredients.name: fry oil
ingredients.notes: Vegetable or peanut oil works well

instructions: Heat oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the earthworms (or vegetables) and cook for 3-4 minutes, or until they start to brown.
Add the grated ginger and stir-fry sauce, and cook for another minute.
Add the flour (if using) and stir-fry for 30 seconds.
Serve the stir-fry over rice or noodles, garnished with chopped scallions.
Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes if using flour.
Season with soy sauce to taste.
